feature_desc.themeSongLightness: How light the accent colours should be that are derived from the current ThemeSong theme
feature_helptext.themeSongLightness:
Depending on the settings you chose for the ThemeSong extension, this feature allows you to adjust the lightness of the accent colours that are derived from the current theme.

This feature will have no effect if the ThemeSong extension is not installed.
feature_helptext.initTimeout: This will not affect the script's behavior in a significant way, but if one of your plugins can't initialise in time, you should try increasing this value.
feature_helptext.advancedMode:
After enabling this, the menu will reload and show advanced settings that are hidden by default.
This is useful if you want to customise the script's behaviour more deeply and don't care about an overcrowded menu.
